# ThunderStudy AI

> ThunderStudy AI is a free educational tool at https://formula.thunderstudy.indevs.in/. Its Formula Story Mode turns any formula or concept into a story, a real-life analogy or a memory trick, for Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Biology and more. It is owned, built and maintained by Wondermayank, a solo student developer who has been building free educational tools since 2018. No account, card or ads. Last updated: 3 October 2026.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://formula.thunderstudy.indevs.in/): Turn any formula into a story, real-life analogy or memory trick with ThunderStudy AI. Free for Physics, Chemistry, Maths and Biology, by Wondermayank.
- [Formula Story Mode](https://formula.thunderstudy.indevs.in/home): Use Formula Story Mode to turn any formula into a story, analogy or memory trick. Free AI tool for Physics, Chemistry, Maths and Biology, with PDF export.
- [About](https://formula.thunderstudy.indevs.in/about): About ThunderStudy AI and its owner Wondermayank: who runs the site, its mission and what it offers.
- [FAQ](https://formula.thunderstudy.indevs.in/faq): Answers about ThunderStudy AI: it is free, needs no account, and covers subjects, story styles, the 5-a-day limit, the free library and saving stories.
- [Changelog](https://formula.thunderstudy.indevs.in/new): Newest-first list of what Wondermayank added, fixed, improved and removed, with dates.
